prompt: A burly middle-aged tavern keeper with a thick black beard, rolled-up sleeves and a stained leather apron, a sarcastic half smile, wiping one pewter tankard with one cloth behind a wooden bar counter, barrels and bottles behind him.

A mysterious hooded storyteller whose face is half hidden in the shadow of a deep grey hood, only a pale chin and a faint knowing smile visible, long pale fingers resting on an old closed book, cold bluish candlelight, a dark corner of a tavern.

A tough old woman, a retired adventurer in her seventies with white hair tied back and an old scar across her cheek, wearing a worn leather breastplate over a wool shirt, holding one clay pipe in her right hand, sitting by a tavern fire, stern but kind eyes.
A heavy iron shield slamming into a dark shape, a burst of sparks and dust at the moment of impact.
A huge two-handed sword blow falling from above, a streak of white light along the blade, stone chips flying.
A tired armoured warrior seen from behind, standing up again with one hand on his knee, warm light breaking through the dust around him.
A lone armoured warrior seen from behind, sword raised high, shouting at a crowd of shadowy monsters that all turn towards him.
A dented steel shield glowing with a faint golden light, arrows and blades bouncing off it in the dark.
A blinding bolt of blue-white lightning striking down in a dark ruined hall, sparks and shattered stone.
A freezing wave of pale blue frost spreading across a stone floor, icicles forming in the air, cold mist.
A shimmering translucent magical barrier of violet runes hanging in the air, a blade stopped against it.
A robed figure dissolving into drifting violet sparks, an empty space where a sword cuts through the air.
Three glowing violet arrows of pure magic flying in a curve through a dark crypt, trails of light behind them.
A curved dagger dripping with a glowing green poison, a single drop falling, dark background.
Two small throwing knives spinning through candlelit air, motion blur, a dark tavern cellar.
A cloaked figure leaping and twisting sideways in mid-air, a heavy axe swinging through the space where he stood.
A hidden rope snare and iron trap snapping shut among dead leaves on a forest path, a cloud of dust.
A sly cloaked rogue whistling and tossing a pebble to one side in a dark corridor, a guard's shadow turning towards the noise.
A ring of soft golden light on the stone floor of a chapel, three wounded travellers inside it bathed in warm glow.
A raised holy sun symbol blazing with white light, skeletal shapes crumbling to dust as the light reaches them.
A dome of pale golden light over a small group of travellers in a dark forest, shadows held back at its edge.
A heavy flanged mace coming down wreathed in golden light, a burst of radiance at the point of impact.
A fallen warrior lying on stone, a column of gentle golden light descending on him, his hand beginning to move.
